response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in C and C++ from early roles (e.g., National Instruments), but the majority of recent work focuses on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, with limited exposure to modern C++ development on the Windows platform. Domain expertise in capital markets or fixed income is not evident, and SQL experience is present but not explicitly tied to SQL Server or Oracle. The resume lacks direct relevance to the financial domain or Windows-based C++ development in recent years.
strengths: Solid foundational C/C++ experience (e.g., National Instruments role)
Strong SQL and database management skills
Proven ability to work in high-performance, low-latency environments (e.g., Dunnhumby)
concerns: Limited recent C++ experience on Windows platform; most recent work focuses on JavaScript/TypeScript
No demonstrated domain expertise in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income
Lacks recent experience with SQL Server or Oracle, focusing more on MongoDB and MySQL
